daily.today_energy: Your intuition is *chef's kiss* today. The cosmos is whispering secrets only you can hear. Trust those gut feelings—they're basically your personal spiritual GPS right now.

daily.career: Your creative ideas are hitting different today. Don't sleep on that random thought you had this morning—it might be the spark your team needs. Your vibe attracts the right opportunities.
daily.health: Your body's asking for slowness today. That could mean a walk, stretching, or just giving yourself permission to rest without guilt. Listen to what feels nourishing, not restrictive.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to get curious about what you've been avoiding. Mercury's vibe is asking you to speak up about something that matters, even if it feels vulnerable. Trust the timing—it's more perfect than you think.
weekly.love: Romantic energy is subtle but real. Whether you're coupled or single, this is about authentic connection over surface-level stuff. Someone might surprise you with genuine effort. Notice who actually shows up for you.

weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. Whatever movement or rest feels right is the move. Check in with yourself emotionally too—sometimes fatigue is about energy alignment, not just sleep.
